name: Software Development
description: An extensible team for taking a software request from scoped intent to independently reviewed, verified delivery.

intake.welcomeMessage: I’m the Team Lead. Your starting artifacts are recorded. The Product Manager will use them to start discovery and follow up here.

inputs: User request, constraints and acceptance expectations
Authorized tools, resources and execution budget
outputs: Delivery summary with limitations and next steps

agents.name: Team Lead
agents.purpose: Receive requests, clarify expectations and keep the user informed as the team works.

agents.name: Delivery Lead
agents.purpose: Turn the user request into a scoped plan and coordinate accountable delivery.
deliverables: Intake brief and accepted requirements baseline
Delivery plan and final evidence summary

readiness.instruction: Record the user’s explicit confirmation of the setup summary before the Team Lead sends new work.

agents.name: Product Manager
agents.purpose: Define the business outcome, prioritize scope and surface decisions for stakeholders.
deliverables: Product brief with outcomes and prioritized scope
Decision log with open questions and owners

readiness.instruction: Confirm what the team is authorized to change or investigate, including consequential constraints.

agents.name: Business Analyst
agents.purpose: Turn prioritized scope into workflows, business rules and testable acceptance criteria.
deliverables: Requirements baseline with workflows, business rules and edge cases
Acceptance criteria mapped to requirement IDs

readiness.instruction: Provide the prioritized product brief and decision log.

agents.name: Solution Architect
agents.purpose: Choose an implementation approach grounded in the existing system.

readiness.instruction: Provide the selected folder path inside the OpenBot project workspace.
readiness.question: Where is the project?

readiness.instruction: Identify the approved branch, tag, commit, or explicitly approved default branch.
Record a successful read of the exact project and revision with the intended bot’s authorized tools. The receiving bot must recheck before doing the work.
Provide the accepted scope and testable requirements, with requirement IDs when available.

agents.name: Software Engineer
agents.purpose: Produce focused changes and meaningful implementation evidence.

readiness.instruction: Provide the selected folder path inside the OpenBot project workspace.
readiness.question: Where is the project?

readiness.instruction: Identify the approved branch, tag, commit, or explicitly approved default branch.
Confirm what the team is authorized to change or investigate, including consequential constraints.
Record a successful read of the exact project and revision with the intended bot’s authorized tools. The receiving bot must recheck before doing the work.
Provide the accepted scope and testable requirements, with requirement IDs when available.
Confirm the intended bot can write to the isolated checkout for that project and revision. Record a tool-backed check and recheck before editing.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.purpose: Find correctness, security and maintainability defects in the proposed changes.
deliverables: Review findings with severity and locations

readiness.instruction: Provide the selected folder path inside the OpenBot project workspace.
readiness.question: Where is the project?

readiness.instruction: Provide the exact candidate commit or patch and its base revision.
Provide the accepted scope and testable requirements, with requirement IDs when available.
Record that the intended bot can read the exact candidate or patch.

agents.name: Quality Engineer
agents.purpose: Verify user-visible behavior and assemble reproducible acceptance evidence.

readiness.instruction: Identify the applicable deployment or verification environment.
Provide the exact candidate commit or patch and its base revision.
Provide the accepted scope and testable requirements, with requirement IDs when available.
Confirm access to the candidate and the intended test or verification environment.

agents.name: Security Specialist
agents.purpose: Assess sensitive data, authentication and exposed trust boundaries.
agents.activateWhen: Authentication, authorization, sensitive data, dependency trust or externally exposed input changes.

readiness.instruction: Provide the selected folder path inside the OpenBot project workspace.
Identify the sensitive features, data or trust boundaries in scope.
Provide the exact candidate commit or patch and its base revision.
Record that the intended bot can inspect the exact candidate.

agents.name: UX Specialist
agents.purpose: Review interaction design and accessibility for user-facing changes.
agents.activateWhen: New or materially changed user-facing workflows, interactions or accessibility requirements.

readiness.instruction: Provide the exact design, prototype, or build reference.

agents.name: Release Engineer
agents.purpose: Prepare approved candidates for release, deploy to the authorized target, and verify the result.
agents.activateWhen: Infrastructure, schema migrations, deployment behavior or operational reliability changes.

readiness.instruction: Identify the applicable deployment or verification environment.
Identify the rollout owner and authorized actions.
Provide the exact candidate commit or patch and its base revision.
Provide the exact deployment, migration, or runbook reference.

agents.name: Technical Writer
agents.purpose: Write or update documentation grounded in the specified source system and audience.
agents.activateWhen: The request includes new or materially changed technical documentation.
deliverables: Documentation draft with source references and open questions

readiness.instruction: Provide the source system URL and version, or the exact source files.
Record a successful authorized read of the specified source with the intended bot’s tools. The writer must recheck before drafting.

tools.description: Inspect repository files, history and diffs.
tools.setup: Register a repository MCP server and grant read access only to the assigned repository.

tools.description: Edit files in the assigned isolated workspace.
tools.setup: Runner provides a per-task writable checkout; do not grant host-wide filesystem access.

tools.description: Run project checks in an isolated execution environment.
tools.setup: Runner provisions a container with the project toolchain; review/QA get independent disposable checkouts.

tools.description: Store task evidence and handoff artifacts.
tools.setup: Provide a request-scoped artifact store; prevent cross-request access.

resources.description: Task brief, stakeholder context and existing requirements.
Request-scoped requirements, patches, reviews and verification evidence.

environments.workspace: Not applicable; use granted remote read tools and artifact services.
environments.setup: No shell or computer required. Network restrictions describe local compute, not brokered tool calls.
Provision one container and branch/worktree per task. Resolve approved hosts explicitly; do not mount credentials or the Docker socket.
Provision independent checkouts of the candidate revision with preinstalled dependencies; source patch editing is not granted.

workflow.instructions: Start from the supplied artifacts and use Product Manager discovery to clarify scope, success criteria and constraints.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Define the business outcome and prioritize scope. Record stakeholder decisions and route unresolved scope decisions to the lead.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Translate the prioritized scope into requirements with stable IDs, business rules, edge cases and measurable acceptance criteria.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Inspect the codebase and design a solution against the accepted requirements baseline.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Implement against the accepted scope in an isolated workspace.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Review the exact proposed revision independently.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Map verification evidence to the accepted requirements and check regressions against the reviewed revision.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

workflow.instructions: Confirm all evidence matches the final revision and report the result.
workflow.onFailure: Return evidence to lead. Rework affected stages and rerun dependent gates; stop at the execution budget.

rules: Core roles are a recommended baseline, not an exhaustive roster.
Add domain specialists with explicit activation triggers, prompts, handoff contracts and grants.
Lead records why a specialist was activated and integrates its findings into the relevant quality gate.
Parallelize independent assignments only; changes to a revision invalidate dependent review evidence.
Version blueprint changes; preserve the independent implementation, review and verification responsibilities.

approvalRequiredFor: Publishing or deployment outside existing request authorization
Destructive changes outside the task scope
New external spending or privileged access
executionPolicy.onBudgetExceeded: Stop new delegation, retain completed evidence and report the remaining blockers to the user.

roles.responsibility: Clarify goals, coordinate the team and report outcomes.
Discover outcomes and define acceptance criteria.
Implement a verified candidate in the project VM.
Plan and execute acceptance testing against the exact candidate.
Prepare approved releases and verify deployment.

workflows.description: Investigate a product question and return a recommendation or change brief.
Clarify the requested feature, define scenarios, implement, verify and release when shipping is requested.
